name: Azalea
text: Once per Turn Action - 0: Put a card from your arsenal on the bottom of your deck. If you do, put the top card of your deck face up into your arsenal. If it's an arrow card, it gains dominate until end of turn. Go again

name: Barbed Castaway
text:
Once per Turn Instant - {r}: You may put an arrow card from your hand face up into your arsenal.
Once per Turn Instant - {r}: You may turn a face down arrow in your arsenal face up. If you do, put an aim counter on it.
